description: This header file defines the interface for the Module Container Object in the ANSC framework. It includes prototypes for functions related to module interface management, lifecycle control, and internal querying mechanisms.

methods.name: AnscMcoGetQueryIfObject
methods.description: Retrieves the query interface object associated with the module container.

methods.name: AnscMcoIgnite
methods.description: Initializes or activates the module container object.

methods.name: AnscMcoPutOut
methods.description: Deactivates or cleans up the module container object.

methods.name: AnscMcoSwitch
methods.description: Enables or disables specific functionalities within the container based on the boolean parameter.

methods.name: AnscMcoAddModuleIf
methods.description: Adds a module interface with the specified name and interface handle to the container.

methods.name: AnscMcoDelModuleIf
methods.description: Removes a module interface by name from the container.

methods.name: AnscMcoQueryModuleIf
methods.description: Retrieves the handle to a module interface by name.

methods.name: AnscMcoRegisterIfs
methods.description: Registers all necessary interfaces for the container.

methods.name: AnscMcoDispatchIfs
methods.description: Dispatches interface handling logic using the provided interface context.
